otj.text: After the Omenpaths open, Thunder Junction's wild magic awakens, which settlers dub thunder, and the plane is overrun with outlaws while the Riveteers build railroads and the Sterling Company keeps the peace.

An ancient vault is discovered there, rumored to hide untold riches and power, and Oko forms a gang of the Multiverse's most wanted to pull off a heist of epic scale, while Kellan tracks down his wayward father.
The gang hijacks a train, and when zombies overrun it Oko abandons the passengers, though Kellan grows magic vines to stall the train and save them.
Oko opens the vault for Jace and Vraska, and Jace takes the toddler-like Loot, whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and the team escapes as the vault collapses.
